stories.title: Court order puts former Hoquiam hotel nonprofit purchased in receivership
stories.summary: The Department of Commerce is asking the nonprofit to provide additional information about how it spent two state grants.

stories.title: How a South Seattle mom and son help feed 2,000 people a month
stories.summary: The Colored Girls Garden Club gives away free groceries twice a week. Every year, that includes Thanksgiving Day.

stories.title: The last supper? Donor’s death puts Thanksgiving tradition for Snohomish County seniors in doubt
stories.summary: For thousands of seniors, a knock on the door on Thanksgiving Day means a hot meal and a friendly face. Now the $10,000 that paid for it is gone.

stories.title: Over 400 Westin Seattle staff to be laid off amid change in operator
stories.summary: Marriott confirmed to KING 5 that the Westin will not operate the Seattle location after Jan. 26.

stories.title: Stolen car suspect hits 2 patrol cars, flees before arrest in Mount Vernon
stories.summary: A Bellingham woman faces multiple charges after allegedly fleeing police in a stolen vehicle and striking patrol cars, according to Mount Vernon Police.

stories.title: Tacoma swap meet manager charged with leading organized crime, selling stolen goods
stories.summary: Macy’s investigators said they bought back a jacket at the swap meet after following people suspected of stealing 26 coats.

stories.title: Expedia investigates cyberattack after hackers claim theft of nearly 1 billion customer records
stories.summary: Expedia is investigating a cyberattack involving a third-party provider after hackers claimed they stole nearly 1 billion records containing customer information.

stories.title: Woman, 18, charged after stolen car catches fire in Puyallup police chase
stories.summary: Officers pulled a girl with a broken leg from the car after it hit a traffic signal pole and went through a fence.

stories.title: Seattle Public Schools pressures court to pause ban on trans athletes in girls’ sports
stories.summary: Seattle Public Schools filed a legal brief on Wednesday night in support of preventing Initiative 638 from taking effect.

stories.title: 2 people shot in Seattle's ​Chinatown-International District
stories.summary: According to the Seattle Police Department, the victims were reportedly shot Wednesday night near 12th Avenue South and South Welles Street.

stories.title: Auburn Riverside tennis star solves Rubik's Cube in under 20 seconds as Ravens chase state championship
stories.summary: Auburn Riverside tennis star Evan Ly, known for solving Rubik's Cubes in seconds, leads his high school team to district victory with sights set on a state title.

stories.title: Skylights return to Washington State Capitol in $8.6 million restoration
stories.summary: The work is scheduled to be complete when legislators return to Olympia next January.
